Name: Dropbear
Author: Xvordan
Description:
Simply mimics the behavior of the delete key which is a shortcut to dropping items in the trash. Pick up an item from your inventory, hit the backspace key (configurable), rather than clicking outside the inventory.

1.1.0 adds the ability to ship the selected item by pressing backslash.

Made mainly for my personal use, but figured someone else *might* find it of interest.

Manifest.Name: Dropbear
Manifest.Description: Press a configurable hotkey (Backspace by default) to drop the item currently held by your cursor, or another (\ by default) to ship it, including when picking items up from any inventory menu or when your bags are full.
